newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Gas Natural shares soar on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Spain Gas Natural shares soar on technical rebound.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Gas Natural soared on Monday in what traders saw as a technical rebound and after a large block trade passed through the market.
"In the last two weeks (Gas Natural's) shares have rebounded twice to around levels seen last Friday and today they have done the same," said one trader.
By 1200 GMT, shares were trading 1,190 points, 4.32 percent, up at 28,750. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares was up 15.97, 0.25 percent, at 6,316.72.
"There has also been a sizeable trade going through which appears to have finished," another trader said.
